# Team JAM — pizza-clip.com

> Team JAM (ProjectJAM) makes two free, 100% local macOS menu-bar apps: PIZZA CLIP, a clipboard-history manager that keeps everything you ⌘C so you can recall it instantly, and PICkle, a screenshot organizer that auto-saves every capture into a tidy "pickle jar." No ads, no tracking — your data never leaves your Mac.

## PIZZA CLIP

A clipboard-history manager that lives in your menu bar. Copy as much as you want — every ⌘C is kept, so nothing you copied earlier ever disappears. Hit one shortcut, grab the slice you need, paste. 🍕

- **Price**: Free (no ads, no tracking)
- **OS**: macOS 13+ — universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel)
- **Privacy**: 100% local, no server. Your clipboard data stays on your Mac.
- **Updates**: Auto-updates via Sparkle; builds are Apple notarized.
- **Developer**: Team JAM (ProjectJAM)

Key features:
- Automatically keeps every text, image, and file you copy — your history never gets wiped.
- Recall the whole stack with ⌘⇧V, then paste any item with ⌘⌥⌃1~9.
- Pin the items you reach for most so they stay at the top.
- Fast search across your history.
- Optional 한/영 (Korean/English) input-source helper on the right ⌘ key.
- Sensitive items like passwords stay local — they never leave your device.

Core shortcuts: ⌘⇧V (open the history popup) · ⌘⌥⌃1~9 (paste a specific item)

- **Official site**: https://pizza-clip.com/pizzaclip (EN: https://pizza-clip.com/en/pizzaclip)
- **Download**: https://github.com/parkppuri01/pizzaClip/releases/latest
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/parkppuri01/pizzaClip

## PICkle

A screenshot organizer for macOS. Every capture is auto-saved, fresh and dated, into a "pickle jar" folder in your Documents — no more screenshots scattered across your Desktop. Quick-edit on the spot, then grab it from the menu-bar tray. 🥒🫙

- **Price**: Free (no ads, no tracking)
- **OS**: macOS 13+ — universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel)
- **Privacy**: 100% local, no server. Captures stay on your Mac.
- **Trust**: Apple notarized — installs with no security warnings.
- **Updates**: Auto-updates built in.
- **Developer**: Team JAM (ProjectJAM)

Key features:
- Auto-saves every screenshot into a "pickle jar" folder inside Documents — organized the moment you capture.
- Quick edit without leaving the app: blur, pen, crop, and watermark.
- Menu-bar tray holds your recent captures, with drag-and-drop into any app.
- Keeps captures preserved and easy to find, never lost on the Desktop.

Core shortcuts: ⇧⌥S · ⇧⌥D · ⇧⌥A · ⇧⌥F

- **Official site**: https://pizza-clip.com/pickle (EN: https://pizza-clip.com/en/pickle)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/parkppuri01/pickle

## FAQ

- **Are they free?** Yes. Both PizzaClip and PICkle are completely free — no ads, no tracking, no account.
- **Which Macs are supported?** Any Mac on macOS 13 or later. Both apps ship as universal binaries for Apple Silicon and Intel.
- **Is it safe? Where does my data go?** Both apps are Apple notarized, so they install without security warnings, and everything is 100% local. Your clipboard history and screenshots stay on your Mac — nothing is sent to a server.
- **How do I paste quickly with PizzaClip?** Press ⌘⇧V to open your clipboard history, then paste any item directly with ⌘⌥⌃1~9.
- **Do they work offline?** Yes. Both apps run entirely on-device, so they work with no internet connection.
- **How are screenshots organized in PICkle?** Every capture is automatically saved into a dated "pickle jar" folder inside your Documents, so they're sorted the instant you take them.
- **Can I edit a screenshot?** Yes. PICkle has built-in quick editing — blur, pen, crop, and watermark — right after you capture.
- **How do I get to my recent screenshots?** They live in the PICkle menu-bar tray; drag any capture straight into another app.
- **Do updates install automatically?** Yes. PizzaClip auto-updates via Sparkle and PICkle has built-in auto-update, both on Apple notarized builds.
- **Who makes these apps?** Team JAM (ProjectJAM), an indie developer building focused, local-first Mac utilities.
